messages:
Hector Alvarez: Heads up 1: Legal locked the deprecation window: 45 days. We need docs + localization + marketing alignment. Main asks: migration guide update, SDK snippets, localized copies (EN/FR/DE/JP), video tutorial script, and embargo timing. Who can take localization and media?
Zoey Lin: I can coordinate localization. Need PR-ready English copy 10 days before publish. I'll create a locale checklist and tag translators.
Benjy Cole: I'll own SDK snippets and changelog entries. Will add v1->v2 mapping table and alias notes. ETA: Thursday.
Rina Gupta: I'll draft the short video script for the migration walkthrough (3-4 min). Will include live demo switching from v1 to v2 on Node.
Hector Alvarez: Add an explicit note for regional rollout: EU endpoints switch only after localized pages are live. Ops wants 48h pause per region.
Localization-Bot: Reminder: upload string-extracts to L10n platform once PR is merged. Supported locales: en, fr, de, ja.
Benjy Cole: Snippet note: change from api_key header to bearer token. Example I'll include in both minimal and expanded forms. Also adding compatibility shim for streaming framing differences.
Zoey Lin: For translations, we'll need sample SDK comments trimmed to short lines (translators prefer <120 chars). Benjy, can you split long comments?
Benjy Cole: Will do. Also adding a small test harness repo link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/migration-smoke. Includes curl, Py, and Node smoke tests.
PR-Bot: New PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501 by Benjy 1 1 (includes snippets and mapping-table).
Rina Gupta: Video script draft: quick problem statement, show v1 call, highlight failure mode, show v2 call, explain model alias fallback. Will share rough cut Wednesday.
Hector Alvarez: Marketing: we need messaging guidance for the blog + in-product banner. Also confirm embargo — marketing wants a 24h notice window.
Marketing: Copying product comms. We'll coordinate the blog post date to match docs publish. Prefer to keep embargo to 24h. Need final screenshots at least 48h prior.
Zoey Lin: Localization timeline: extract strings upon merge, T+4 days for first pass, T+7 for review. Tag translations "sr-migration".
Benjy Cole: Added migration mapping table snippet:
```
# Model name map
legacy-chat -> redwood-chat
embed-128 -> redwood-embed-512 (pad to 512 recommended)
```
Hector Alvarez: PTO/coverage note: if any reviewer is OOO during go/no-go, please set a delegate.
Benjy Cole: Small curl shim example for streaming framing:
```
# shim to convert v2 framed events to legacy ndjson
node shim.js --listen 8080 --target https://api.redwood.ai/v2/stream
```
Localization-Bot: L10n tasks created: 4 locales, owner @zoey.
Hector Alvarez: Let's add an explicit rollback step: revert docs site deploy + revert redirect table, and set flag 'docs_deprecation_hold=true'. Include contacts for infra and eng-oncall.
Rina Gupta: Uploaded draft script to PR comments. Link added.
PR-Bot: CI passed for PR #501. Tests: snippet-lint, smoke-tests (partial).
Zoey Lin: Will request translators to prioritize FAQ and error messages first. Those must be accurate.
Benjy Cole: Note for SDK owners: also bump changelog with breaking note and add migration snippet near top of README.
Hector Alvarez: Final: schedule #docs-review for Mon 09:00 PT to approve final copy and localized readiness check. If any blockers, hold public announcement. Thanks.
